facts.fact_text: The applicant, together with a number of other members of the Popular Front Party of Azerbaijan, was arrested during the dispersal of an unauthorised demonstration held on 23 November 2006.

Similar decisions to the Sabail District Court's decision of 23 November 2006 appear to have been given in respect of a number of others arrested in connection with the demonstration of 23 November 2006.
The applicant, together with a number of other members of the Popular Front Party of Azerbaijan, was arrested during the dispersal of an unauthorised demonstration held on 23 November 2006.
On 23 November 2006, the Sabail District Court convicted the applicant under Article 310.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences, relying on the related administrative offence report.
On 23 November 2006, the Sabail District Court sentenced the applicant to ten days' administrative detention.
The applicant was not represented during the pre-trial stage of the administrative proceedings.
The applicant was not represented during the trial stage of the administrative proceedings.
On 27 November 2006, the Baku Court of Appeal held a hearing in the applicant's absence.
On 27 November 2006, the Baku Court of Appeal upheld the Sabail District Court's decision of 23 November 2006.

On 12 June 2008, the Sabail District Court dismissed the applicant's civil action seeking compensation for his unlawful arrest on 23 November 2006.
